bio: Planning a romantic night out? Then secure a table at this beautifully restored traditional farmhouse, where the view of the Terworm estate will captivate throughout your meal. A glance at the menu reveals a creative take on fine dining – technically refined, bold and replete with influences from around the globe. For instance, the chef coats a fillet of skrei with a light aubergine caviar and finishes it with a crumble of panko, pistachio and herbs, then serves it with a lukewarm mirin broth. Darwin is a restaurant where diners are kept on their toes from start to finish....
